text:
emma: Morning folks — building a tiny micro-guide for new hires: who to ping for VPC peering, private deploy perms, canary approvals, SLA pages, and commercial questions. Trying to keep it to one page.

rick: Quick map: eng-infra = VPC peering & low-level creds; people-ops = onboarding & IAM baseline; eng-platform = private deploy orchestration & gating; eng-runtime = canary infra + rollout tooling; eng-sre = incident ops/SLA; sales-ops = dedicated capacity/contracts; security-privacy = data residency/compliance.

sofia: Short escalation rules: P1 (production outage) -> page #eng-oncall + @eng-sre + runtime lead + product lead; P2 (canary/regression affecting a subset) -> page @eng-runtime and open "rollout-help" ticket; P3 -> ticket to runtime/product.

dev-ops-bot: eng-infra office hours: Tue 10:00 PT. For urgent VPC requests file ticket with label "vpc-urgent".

emma: Can someone paste a one-line cheatsheet and a copyable P1 page snippet I can put in the wiki?

rick: Copy this one-liner and P1 snippet: 
```
Who-to-ping: eng-infra (VPC/creds), people-ops (onboarding), eng-platform (private deploys), eng-runtime (canaries & rollouts), eng-sre (incidents), sales-ops (contracts), security-privacy (compliance).

P1 PAGE TEMPLATE:
SERVICE: <service-name>
SEVERITY: P1 - production impact
WHAT: <short description of failure>
IMPACT: <customers / regions>
ACTION: immediate mitigation + rollback if safe
CONTACT: <your-name>
```

sofia: Add timezone guidance: if incident originates APAC hours, page regional oncall first; #eng-oncall will escalate if no ack. For after-hours canary rollbacks, if rollback is safe do it and then page runtime-oncall.

dev-ops-bot: #eng-oncall next rotation primary: Alex.R on 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC.

emma: Awesome, I'll add this to the onboarding micro-guide and link the runbook. Can you add me to the "who-to-ping" sheet?

rick: Done — added you and flagged the sheet for a quick review. Happy to review the micro-guide once you draft it.

emma: Thanks all :wave: will drop a draft in the wiki later today.
